branchName.instructions: Use `<type>/<short-kebab-slug>`, type one of feat, fix, chore, design, docs; with a GitHub issue `<type>/<issue>-<slug>`, e.g. `feat/12-my-work-list`.

commitMessage.instructions: English, imperative, no prefix, no trailing period; the subject says what changes for the user or the code, e.g. `Show review requests first in My work`.

pullRequest.instructions: The title becomes the squash commit on main, so it follows the commit message style: English, imperative, no prefix. The body is in Polish: what changed and why; keep `Closes #<issue>` when the branch has an issue.
